responsibility: Documents GCC's static analyzer internals and developer-facing debugging workflow. It explains the analyzer as a read-only GIMPLE SSA based interprocedural analysis that builds a supergraph from CFGs and the callgraph, explores program states in an exploded graph, tracks state machines and call strings, and emits path-based diagnostics; it also records the dump switches, gdb helpers, and special builtin-like debugging functions used to inspect analyzer state and diagnostics.
